title: eat shit & die 163
author: bpatrick
body: By request: another Onan. I’m going to start next week’s comic right now. The site going down really got to me. It made me realize how much I like sharing comics with people. Thanks for reading!

comments.author: Winston Rowntree
comments.text: I love the tone of these. If you do them by request then consider this another request!

comments.author: kittencontinues
comments.text: good to see you’re back, awesome scene. Your compositions are awesome.

comments.text: Thanks for sharing ! and thanks for being awesome!

comments.text: Glad you’re back dude, you make some damn fine comics

comments.text: Man. You really need to make this one of your regulars. It deserves a spot of it’s own on the right side.

comments.author: Jonny Paycheck
comments.text: Onan always leaves me with a sense of wonder. Wonder what he’s searching for. Wonder what he’ll find.

comments.author: Jada
comments.text: Man, I was super bummed when I saw the site was down. So glad to see ya back.
